notes: Actually opened full selected V2 portrait and full native individually. Same warm tan lean cartographer, black long swept anatomical RIGHT hair/LEFT undercut, purple ragged gold-trim coat/scarf, dark blue shirt, crossed leather straps/multiple belts/cyan tools/fingerless gloves/two tall whole boots. Anatomical RIGHT open hand projects cyan gridded chart; LEFT hand controls tall brass handle attached to large tilted map frame, lower cyan orb and cylindrical brass pedestal on ground supports. Complete main frame/orb/cylinder/support feet and both boots inside margins; no portable/folded conversion claimed. Dawn harbor empty around subject differs from source night/contextual crowd. Tiny control geometry and hidden rear parts not certified.
